profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
An experienced, self motivated software engineer/architect with 15+ years of experience specializing in web and mobile technologies with a history of delivering highly scalable solutions used by thousands of users in healthcare providers across the country. Have led multiple development teams charged with delivering innovative strategic solutions using agile development methodologies.

Specialties:
• Languages -C#, JavaScript, Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, Java, HTML, CSS, SQL, JSON, Ruby
• Frameworks - VueJs, React, Angular, ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, REST, Web API, Cocoa
• Platforms - iOS, Android, Mac OS X, Windows 
• DBMS - SQL Server, MySQL/MariaDB, Couchbase, Mongo

positions.title: iOS Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: iOS Development · Python (Programming Language) · Swift (Programming Language) · Objective-C

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built & maintained backend api & database for quest/item/inventory/currency/reward systems to support multiple games along with SPA front end management portals for game designers. (Spring & React)
Extracted game logic from Unity server code to run behind API's to reduce server deployment costs and increase scaling. (C#)
Led multiple scaling & performance efforts resulting in 10x concurrent user count support without increasing hardware requirements.
Built and deployed micro-services responsible for NFT Drops. (python, golang)
Built marketing sites for multiple games, supporting player purchases, announcements, profile mgmt etc. (ReactJS/NextJS/Spring/Kotlin)

positions.title: Enterprise Architect
positions.description:
Drove the adoption of secure coding practices, formalized code review processes, and integrated code scanning tool into the CI pipelines.

Built, maintained, and led the execution of the technical roadmap driving the migration to Azure based cloud-native technologies, reducing infrastructure costs, and supporting business directives from senior leadership.

Led a small team (3) of engineers & architects, responsible for building scaffolding and foundational components of the next generation platform. (.NET Core, VueJS).

Performed advanced trouble shooting, and optimizations of SQL queries and indexes, contributed heavily to the code base in areas related to performance and stability.

positions.title: Lead Architect
positions.description:
Creation and development of a custom DSL derived from CMS OASIS regulations, allowing clinical analysts to describe rules which compile & transpile to multiple languages which generated an SDK to provide real-time logic validation of OASIS assessments.
Led mobile development of multiple native iOS applications which securely store PHI to support offline clinical documentation, supporting bi-directional data synchronization.
Defined and implemented frameworks and standards for HIPAA/HITRUST compliant authentication and data storage on mobile devices.
Designed and built a content management system allowing clinicians to define the documentation for clinical assessments for both mobile and web.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Built and maintained websites utilizing Opensource software (Joomla CMS, CakePHP, Kohana, CodeIgniter)
Installed and maintained Accounting ERP and POS Systems (Openbravo POS/ERP)
Maintained multiple web-servers(Centos), responsible for hosting approximately 25 websites.
Installed and maintained network devices (routers, switches, servers etc)
Provided telephone, on-site, and remote support for all systems implemented.
Maintenance on networks across all 3 major OS platforms (Mac,*nix, and windows).

positions.title: Systems Architect
positions.description:
Research and development for NIST compliant authentication components for 
mobile and server platforms used in an offline capable mobile application which stores PHI.(Java, C# and Objective-C/Swift)
Lead Architect and engineer for a native iOS mobile application targeting healthcare para-professionals that includes NIST compliant authentication and data encryption for PHI, with support for offline use and transparent data synchronization. (Swift, C#)
Designed/Architected an engine which synchronized data from a relational to non-relational database and back, leading a team in its development completion.

Team Lead and member of the architecture team.
Mentored new developers, creating a plan for quick integration into ongoing projects.
Created and maintain coding standards, conduct code reviews and task assignments.

Architected and implemented an automated test API for integration between QTP (HP QuickTest Professional) and CEF (a chromium based embedded web-browser).(C#, VB)
Lead Engineer for web-based healthcare application(C#, MVC, HTML5/Javascript)
Other work included Android application development, internal QA tool development, and 
several cryptography rewrites for various areas within existing product.

positions.title: Technical Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for new Installation and Major Version Upgrades of a java based Health care application installed remotely on client’s networks.
Maintained a small set of Windows and Linux servers for a hosted, java based Health Care application
Provided day-to-day technical support for both application systems.

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description:
Maintained small network, website and general computer equipment (routers, printers)
Learned and implemented standards required by USPS to qualify for Bulk Mail rates.
Database Management and Maintenance of mailing lists, template creation for printing.
Scripting for cleaning, editing and modifying mailing lists. (PHP)
Installed and serviced mailing equipment including but not limited to high speed printers, belt-driven inserters and suction feed inserters, tabbing machines and ink-drying equipment. 
Created and maintained training materials and practices used to assure adherence to USPS regulations.; IT Manager, AR/AP, Purchasing (Peachtree, PHP, JS, MySQL, Apache)

positions.title: Purchasing, IT Manager
positions.description:
Purchasing, Inventory analysis, reporting.
Network and telephony maintenance. Web site management and design.

honors.title: 2016 Tech Star Winner
honors.description: Awarded for the Technical Expertise category,  based on the architecture and security work done for a mobile health application.  Each year 8 total Tech Stars are given out, each aligning to a development category.

projects.title: Wakfu Elements
projects.description:
A fan based website for the game Wakfu, driven by data which is mined from the client game files.
The site is written and developed using PHP MVC Framework Kohana along with HTML/CSS/Javascript, and a MySQL backend.
Game data is gathered through reverse engineering of client binary files using Java, and C#.
Wakfu-Elements market contents are gathered through a game client written in c#, which parses server packets, gathering listings data.
Drop data is gathered using Erlang for both proxy packet parsing and site scraping of official game Encyclopedia
